items.snippet: Solidigm拟通过IPO为AI扩张融资，但股东担忧股权稀释，双方分歧令上市前景蒙上阴影。
items.raw_snippet: According to industry sources and foreign media reports on Oct. 18, Solidigm has selected Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley as lead underwriters for a potential initial public offering (IPO) and is considering a Nasdaq listing next year. Market estimates put Solidigm’s valuation at up to $150 billion, or approximately 210 trillion won, while the offering could raise as much as $15 billion, or about 21 trillion won. SK hynix has said that no decisions have been finalized. However, reports that [...] As Solidigm, SK hynix’s U.S.-based NAND flash subsidiary, steps up preparations for a potential U.S. stock market listing, debate over the plan is intensifying. The central conflict is between the view that substantial fundraising is essential for SK hynix to strengthen its position in the artificial intelligence (AI) memory market and concerns that a separate listing of Solidigm could undermine the value of shares held by SK hynix shareholders. [...] SK hynix faces substantial investment requirements in AI-related semiconductor businesses, including high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and advanced packaging. If Solidigm raises funds independently through an IPO, it could ease the parent company’s financing burden and allow SK hynix to concentrate more resources on its core businesses. Supporters argue that stronger long-term earnings could ultimately benefit shareholders through dividends and other forms of returns.

Antropic is preparing for the largest-ever initial public offering (IPO) in the form of a public corporation (PBC). The governance structure of the fund and the standard value of the stake expansion will be disclosed in the next few months. The market is paying attention to whether Antropics can be recognized for its corporate value of up to $2 trillion (about 2,800 trillion won). [...] Whenever the company's value rises by 50% over the set standard value, it will hand over an additional 2% stake at the discretion of the board of directors. The more the company grows, the larger the stake used in the public interest.

Antropics cited the impact of AI on the labor market as a prime example, saying that the fund could be used for large-scale donations to non-profit organizations or direct distribution to specific classes. [...] "AI can create enormous economic value, but it can also lead to instability for many workers," Antropics said. "Considering the pace of AI development, a bolder approach may be needed."

Antropics previously agreed to $200 million for research and response to AI's labor market impact, and this fund is the nature of expanding it.

items.title: 打造以AI速度演进的技术人才队伍：Andela Carrol Chang访谈
items.snippet: 职位名称已难以反映技术岗位实质，企业需构建能随AI快速迭代的技术人才体系。
items.raw_snippet:
A job title no longer tells you what a technical role actually requires, now that AI has changed how the work gets done.

In this episode, Carrol Chang, CEO of Andela, unpacks how AI is reshaping technical roles, and why hiring and assessment need to shift from job titles to skills.

The conversation covers how leaders can assess for judgment and problem-solving rather than just technical output, and how to map a workforce for reskilling as roles continue to change. [...] This episode is sponsored by Andela.

ML Software Engineer in AI/ML team will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning to improve GEV commercial products and internal processes. ML Software Engineer will work closely with data scientists, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality, scalable, and efficient software solutions

  

Responsibilities [...] Provide technical solutions in technology and design. Collaborate with data scientists to integrate AI/ML models into software solutions
 Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
 Design and architect scalable and efficient software systems. Ensure the scalability, performance, and security of software applications
 Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code [...] Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in AI/ML and software engineering
 Contribute to the development of internal tools and processes to improve operational efficiency
